en.headline: Sean Shibe and Ema Nikolovska perform Orlando Variations at City Hall tonight
en.dek: The Scottish guitarist and mezzo-soprano bring their programme inspired by Virginia Woolf’s novel to Hong Kong City Hall Concert Hall at 7:30pm, with tickets from HK$180.
body: Scottish guitarist Sean Shibe returns to Hong Kong tonight with mezzo-soprano Ema Nikolovska for a performance of Orlando Variations at the Hong Kong City Hall Concert Hall.

The programme draws on Virginia Woolf’s novel Orlando and interweaves readings with music spanning centuries, including works by John Dowland, Franz Schubert, Bob Dylan, Laurie Anderson and Thomas Adès. Both artists are former BBC New Generation Artists and Borletti-Buitoni Trust Award winners. Shibe performs on both acoustic and electric guitar.

The concert begins at 7:30pm and lasts approximately 100 minutes including an interval. Tickets are priced at HK$520, HK$320 and HK$180. The pair have previously performed the programme at venues including Wigmore Hall in London.

zh.headline: 蕭恩施貝與艾瑪·妮歌露芙絲嘉今晚大會堂演出《奧蘭多變奏曲》
zh.dek: 蘇格蘭結他家與女中音將維珍妮亞·吳爾芙小說啟發的曲目帶到中環香港大會堂音樂廳，晚上7時30分開始，票價由180元起。
body: 蘇格蘭結他演奏家蕭恩施貝今晚與女中音艾瑪·妮歌露芙絲嘉在香港大會堂音樂廳演出《奧蘭多變奏曲》。
節目以維珍妮亞·吳爾芙小說《奧蘭多》為靈感，結合朗讀與跨時代音樂，包括道蘭、舒伯特、卜戴倫、勞莉·安德森及湯瑪斯·阿迪斯的作品。兩位均為英國廣播公司前新世代藝術家及波爾列堤–布依東尼基金獎得主。施貝會以原聲及電結他演出。
演出於晚上7時30分開始，全長約100分鐘（包括中場休息）。票價為520元、320元及180元。兩人此前曾在倫敦威格摩音樂廳等地演出此節目。
